rationale: Managers work in every industry: use all businesses
Business and financial operations staff cluster in finance and insurance
and in professional services (accounting and consulting firms)
Computer and mathematical jobs cluster in the information sector
and in professional services (computer systems design)
Engineers cluster in professional services (engineering firms)
and in manufacturing
Life and social scientists mostly work in scientific research and development services
Community and social service jobs mostly sit in social assistance
Legal jobs sit in professional services (legal services)
Teachers work in educational services
Arts and media jobs cluster in information (publishing and broadcasting)
and in arts and entertainment
Healthcare practitioners work in health care
Healthcare support jobs work in health care
Private security guards are employed by security services in administrative and support services
Food preparation and serving jobs work in accommodation and food services
Building cleaning and maintenance staff are employed by services to buildings in administrative and support services
Personal care and service jobs cluster in other services (personal care services)
and in social assistance (care for the elderly and children)
Sales jobs cluster in retail trade
and in wholesale trade
Office and administrative support jobs spread across industries: administrative and support services
and finance and insurance hold the largest shares
Farming fishing and forestry jobs sit in agriculture
Construction jobs sit in construction
Installation and repair jobs cluster in other services (repair and maintenance)
and in construction
Production jobs sit in manufacturing
Transportation and material moving jobs sit in transportation and warehousing
